target.title: feat: block broad protected-root shell searches
target.body:
Closes #99466
Related: #99551

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Codex/OpenClaw workers could run broad recursive shell searches over high-risk roots such as a home directory, Codex/OpenClaw state, session archives, repo parents, or external workspace roots. On small PR tasks this can turn command output and local session/debug surfaces into oversized live context, making runaway token usage much more likely.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a high-confidence exec guard for `rg`, recursive `grep`, and `find` commands in gateway/sandbox execution. The guard reuses OpenClaw's existing command-payload analysis so shell wrappers and command carriers are inspected, blocks only protected-root search shapes, and returns actionable guidance to narrow the path, prefer indexed/search tools, and cap output.

This first pass does not add a user-configurable bypass. It is intentionally scoped to the riskiest broad search shapes from the worker-runaway retro and keeps narrowed repo/task/evidence-path searches allowed.

## User Impact

Agents get an immediate, actionable exec failure instead of walking large protected roots. Narrow searches inside a repo or task directory continue to work, and the exec tool description now teaches the safer default before the command is attempted.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts`
  - `src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts`: 8 passed
  - `src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts`: 43 passed
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts`
  - 53 passed
- `git diff --check`

Public issue/PR artifacts intentionally avoid raw private transcripts, cookies, endpoint secrets, and full local session logs.

## Mergeability Proof Update (2026-07-04)

Redacted behavior proof for ClawSweeper, from PR head `29aef945f023cb2a5ebbe7b9170d799f2386c7c2`:

- Fixed ClawSweeper P2: subshell `cd` no longer leaks into later outer commands; cwd tracking is scoped by enclosing shell parentheses.
- Fixed CI failure in `checks-node-compact-large-whole-1`: exact deferred-followup guidance tests now include the new search-safety sentence in the exec tool description.
- Runtime guard proof, using the same pre-exec guard called by gateway/sandbox execution and without running any filesystem search:
  - `rg timeout` from `<HOME>`: blocked over protected root `<HOME>`.
  - `find src -name '*.ts'` from `/Volumes/LEXAR/repos/openclaw`: allowed as a narrowed repo search.
  - `(cd ~/.codex/sessions); rg timeout` from `/Volumes/LEXAR/repos/openclaw`: allowed because the later `rg` runs in the outer repo cwd.
  - `(cd ~/.codex/sessions; rg timeout)` from `/Volumes/LEXAR/repos/openclaw`: blocked over protected root `<HOME>/.codex/sessions`.
- Regression proof: `does not leak subshell cd into later outer commands` and `keeps subshell cd scoped to commands inside the same subshell` were added.
- Focused validation run after the latest fix: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/agent-tools.deferred-followup-guidance.test.ts` passed, 3 tests.
- Focused validation run after the latest fix: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts` passed, 24 tests.
- Focused validation run after the latest fix: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts` passed, 96 tests.
- Focused validation run after the latest fix: `git diff --check && node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.ts src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts src/agents/bash-tools.descriptions.ts src/agents/agent-tools.deferred-followup-guidance.test.ts` passed.
- Policy boundary: v1 intentionally keeps a fail-closed/no-bypass default for high-confidence protected-root searches; an audited bypass can be discussed as a follow-up if maintainers want one.



## Mergeability Proof Update (2026-07-04, head 937302b1b0)

- Fixed current P2 review: `cd` cwd tracking now only adopts a target directory when it resolves with `realpath`; failed `cd /definitely-missing...; rg token` preserves the original protected cwd and blocks broad search. Regression: `preserves cwd when a failed cd would leave the shell in place`.
- Fixed current P2 review: GitHub runner-style workspace parents such as `/home/runner/work/openclaw` are protected when a job runs inside `/home/runner/work/openclaw/openclaw` and searches `..`. Regression: `blocks searches over GitHub runner-style repo parents`.
- Existing subshell cwd regressions were kept machine-independent by creating a temporary synthetic `~/.codex/sessions` path, so CI no longer depends on local session directories existing.
- Runtime guard proof after these fixes, without running any filesystem search: `failed-cd-from-home` blocked over `<HOME>`; `runner-parent-rg` blocked over `<RUNNER_HOME>/work/openclaw`; narrowed repo `find src -name "*.ts"` remained allowed.
- Focused validation after these fixes: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts` passed, 26 tests.
- Focused validation after these fixes: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts` passed, 96 tests.
- Focused validation after these fixes: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/agent-tools.deferred-followup-guidance.test.ts` passed, 3 tests.
- Focused validation after these fixes: `git diff --check && node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.ts src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts src/agents/bash-tools.descriptions.ts src/agents/agent-tools.deferred-followup-guidance.test.ts` passed.



## Mergeability Proof Update (2026-07-04, head 510ed9485d)

- Fixed current P2 review: shell `cd` no longer mutates tracked cwd when the parsed command is inside an `if ... then ... fi` body that may not execute. Regression: `does not apply cd from an unexecuted control-flow branch`.
- Fixed current P2 review: `rg -E` is now treated as a value-taking encoding option. Regression coverage is in `skips rg value operands before inferring implicit cwd searches`.
- Fixed current P2 review: `find --` now skips the option terminator before collecting path operands. Regression: `skips find option terminators before path operands`.
- Fixed current P2 review: sandbox broad-search checks now resolve against the sandbox container cwd, not only the host mirror path. Regression: `checks sandbox broad searches against the container cwd`.
- Fixed current P2 review: shell `~` expands against OS shell home even when `OPENCLAW_HOME` differs. Regression: `expands shell tilde against OS home instead of OPENCLAW_HOME`.
- Fixed current P2 review: `env -C` / `--chdir` cwd is preserved while unwrapping command carriers. Regression: `preserves env --chdir cwd when unwrapping command carriers`.
- Fixed current P2 review: descendants of protected Codex/OpenClaw state roots are blocked, with deepest-root diagnostics. Regression: `blocks descendants of protected state roots`.
- Fixed current P2 review: shell positional dispatch wrappers using `$@` / `$*` are analyzed. Regression: `resolves shell positional dispatch wrappers`.
- Fixed current P2 review: pathless `rg` in a pipeline is treated as stdin filtering, not an implicit filesystem search. Regression: `does not treat piped rg filters as filesystem searches`.
- Focused validation after these fixes: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts src/agents/agent-tools.deferred-followup-guidance.test.ts` passed, 33 + 97 + 3 tests.
- Focused validation after these fixes: `git diff --check && node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.ts src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts src/agents/bash-tools.descriptions.ts src/agents/agent-tools.deferred-followup-guidance.test.ts` passed.



## Mergeability Proof Update (2026-07-04, head 43eddb3210)

- Fixed current P2 review: `cd` behind `&&` / `||` short-circuit operators no longer mutates the analyzer cwd for later commands. This keeps `false && cd /tmp; rg timeout` and `true || cd /tmp; rg timeout` checked against the original protected cwd. Regression: `does not apply cd from short-circuit shell branches`.
- Focused validation after this fix: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts src/agents/agent-tools.deferred-followup-guidance.test.ts` passed, 34 + 97 + 3 tests.
- Focused validation after this fix: `git diff --check && node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.ts src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.path.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec.ts src/agents/bash-tools.descriptions.ts src/agents/agent-tools.deferred-followup-guidance.test.ts` passed.



## Mergeability Proof Update (2026-07-04, head 5f730bea25)

- Fixed current P2 review: cwd changes inside shell control-flow bodies now fail closed by marking the analyzer cwd unknown/protected for later implicit pathless searches. Regression: `fails closed after cwd changes inside shell control flow`.
- Fixed current P2 review: configured OpenClaw state roots are protected when `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` is set, including shell-expanded `$OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` paths. Regression: `protects configured OpenClaw state roots`.
